user.title: Rinnai Boiler
user.description: Enter the RoomControlId of your Rinnai remote (its Wi-Fi MAC, 12 hex characters) and the DeviceId of a phone already registered in the Rinnai app. The cloud only accepts a DeviceId it already knows.

error.invalid_id: The identifier must be 12 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_room_control_id: The Rinnai cloud does not recognise this remote.
error.invalid_device_id: DeviceId must be a UUID, for example A1B2C3D4-1234-5678-9ABC-DEF012345678.
